settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know before you buy.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.content: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days within the US. International shipping takes 10-14 business days.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.content: We offer a 30-day return policy on all unworn items with tags attached. Sale items are final sale.

settings.heading: How do the sizes fit?
settings.content: Our pieces run true to size with a relaxed fit. We recommend sizing up if you prefer an oversized look.

settings.heading: Will there be restocks?
settings.content: Most items are limited edition and will not be restocked. Join our newsletter to be notified of future drops.

settings.heading: Where are your products made?
settings.content: All products are designed in-house and manufactured in ethical, fair-wage facilities across the US and Portugal.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.content: You'll receive a tracking number via email once your order ships. You can also track it in your account.

settings.heading: Still have questions?
settings.text: Our team is here to help. Reach out and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
